name: Doorbell camera
summary: Slim wall-mounted video doorbell with a round lens and a glowing button ring; use for front door and visitor scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: wall mount: the bottom of the doorbell sits on y on the wall (not standing on the floor)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the doorbell is hero size (about 480 px tall)

params.name: anim
params.note: glow = the button ring glows softly

author: krakujs
